products.name: AlphaSense
products.note: Market intelligence AI; financial research; insider information risk; MNPI controls needed

profile_text.body:
AlphaSense is a market intelligence and search platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes its platform as covering more than 500 million documents, allowing users to search company insights, market data, and research. Its stated customers include Recurve Capital and Royalty Pharma, which the company says use the platform for financial research and biopharma due diligence respectively.

The company's core AI product, also called AlphaSense, is categorized as a Finance and Legal AI tool. The platform incorporates features the company calls Smart Synonyms, Expert Insights, and Deep Research, the last of which the company describes as providing access to generative AI reasoning models across its content sets. AlphaSense states its outputs include sentence-level citations and are designed to avoid hallucinations. The site notes that the platform received the highest possible score across 14 criteria in an unspecified report, which describes AlphaSense as having "dominated the market with its vision of marrying premier and exclusive content with domain-specific AI." Given its focus on financial research and insider information, the held facts note that use of the platform carries material non-public information considerations and that MNPI controls may be needed.

The site's held facts record 299 legal cases associated with New York jurisdiction, though no specific litigation details are provided in the available data. AlphaSense has a verified presence in this reference registry as of August 2026.
